mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auction (ticket_id, start_time, end_time, current_bid, status) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{currentBid}, 'ongoing')
mapper.select: SELECT auction.*, winner.username AS winner_username FROM auction LEFT JOIN user winner ON winner.id = auction.winner_id WHERE auction.status = 'ongoing' AND auction.end_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY auction.end_time ASC
